calls.video_title: Market Volatility Is Back — Here’s How to Profit in 15 Minutes
calls.thesis: Guests (Brian, short-term): Triple Q (QQQ) dark-ticker dip trade on the same trigger — buy only if it closes down 1% or more, hold 1-2 days, sell on the next-day rebound. Polarised views on AI / Mag 7 valuations drive $10 up and down days. They cite 80-85% odds of a green point next day after a 1% fall, ~90% after 2% and 100% in their backtest after 5%. No price stated. First tracked MarketBeat call on QQQ.
